user.title: Set up Autodarts
user.description: Enter the public client ID registered with Autodarts for this integration, with device authorization enabled. This is an application ID, not your email, board ID or a secret. Optionally enter your local board IP. The next screen will show your login code.

reauth_confirm.title: Link Autodarts again
reauth_confirm.description: Link your account with the new Autodarts device login. Enter a public client ID registered for this integration with device authorization enabled. Your board, entities and local settings will be kept.

auth_retry.title: Restart Autodarts login
auth_retry.description: Submit to return to the client settings and request a new login code.

boards.title: Load Autodarts boards
boards.description: Your account is linked. Submit to retry loading your boards.

board.title: Select Board
board.description: Choose the Autodarts board to monitor.

progress.wait_for_device:
Open [Autodarts login]({verification_uri_complete}) and approve the connection. Alternatively, open [{verification_uri}]({verification_uri}) on another device and enter **{user_code}**.

This screen continues automatically after approval. Only share this code with your own Autodarts login.

error.invalid_client: This client ID is invalid or is not enabled for device login. Check the client ID for this integration.
error.expired_token: The login code expired. Please request a new code.
error.access_denied: The connection was denied. Please restart login and approve it.
error.invalid_auth: Autodarts could not authorize this connection. Please link your account again.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Autodarts. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Autodarts board is already configured.
abort.no_boards: No boards found for this account.
abort.wrong_account: The linked account does not have access to the existing board. Please link the account that owns this board.
abort.reauth_successful: Autodarts was linked successfully. Your board and entities have been kept.
